title: Sliding-Window Text Chunker
summary: Split a long document into overlapping fixed-size chunks by token count, the way a RAG ingestion pipeline would.
description:
## Scenario

Before a document can be embedded and indexed for retrieval, it has to be split into chunks small enough to embed meaningfully and retrieve precisely. Overlap between consecutive chunks matters: without it, a sentence that straddles a chunk boundary loses context on both sides.

## Task

Implement in `solution.py`:

- `chunk_tokens(tokens: list[str], chunk_size: int, overlap: int) -> list[list[str]]` — splits a token list into chunks of `chunk_size` tokens, where each chunk after the first starts `chunk_size - overlap` tokens after the previous chunk started.

## Requirements

- `overlap < chunk_size` is guaranteed by the caller — you don't need to validate it.
- The last chunk may be shorter than `chunk_size` (whatever tokens remain).
- No token is skipped: every index from `0` to `len(tokens) - 1` appears in at least one chunk.
- `chunk_tokens([], 10, 2)` returns `[]` — no empty chunks are ever produced.
- If `len(tokens) <= chunk_size`, the result is a single chunk containing all tokens.
